caption:
Friday morning: send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ today.

Allah sends His blessings upon the Prophet, and His angels pray for him. Then He calls the believers to invoke blessings upon him too, and to send him greetings of peace.

Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:56

How many times will you send blessings on him before Jumu'ah?

#jumuah #salawat #fridayreminder #durood #quran
